notes.title: Cheritz's Second Game, Nameless Steam Release!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/337930
http://store.steampowered.com/app/339750/

Nameless is now available on Steam! We are glad that Nameless can reach more Otome gamers. A Steam key is offered for previous Nameless purchasers and future Nameless purchasers from Cheritz!

If you would like to play Nameless on Steam, just follow the instructions on the website. We recommend you participate in the Steam review event as well. Every participant will get a free postcard! (See the next announcement for details.)

Thank you so much for your love and support. Also, please be patient with Cheritz's new title revealing soon!
